biggest_catch: No numeric shop pay published — payments vary per shop and are shown only on the notification — and checks are mailed monthly, so cash arrives slowly.
catches: No numeric pay range published; each shop's pay shown only on its notification.
Payment is by mailed check only; no PayPal or direct deposit.
Checks cut at end of the following month; slow cash cycle.
Shops not completed exactly as instructed are not paid, including reimbursements.

c1.evidence: Official mystery-shoppers.com/faqs: MSPA member mystery shopping company using the Sassie platform; detailed shopper FAQ with scam warnings.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Payments vary for each shop, you will know how much the shop pays when you receive the shop notification.' Amount not published as a range.

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: 'We do not use PayPal. All checks are cut at the end of the following month the shop was completed' then mailed to your home.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'There is NEVER a fee for shoppers to pay in order to shop for us.'

Apply for shops and get accepted by the scheduler
